long_biography.plain_text:
Sergey Vasiliev transferred his half of Petersburg Oil Terminal to his wife, Elena, in December 2022. The gift followed the registration of the stake in his own name earlier that year, replacing ownership through his Cyprus holding company, Mobalco.

His business holdings also extended to financial investments. The terminal had separated its investment subsidiaries from its operating business to secure financing for reconstruction. That June, Vasiliev became the full owner of one of these businesses, Vega Finans, through two companies: Asset Management and SVS. His brother Boris managed SVS, the vehicle through which Vasiliev held the final portion of the investment company.
